若 $\Omega: \sqrt{x^2+y^2}\leq z\leq\sqrt{2-x^2-y^2}$，则 $\iiint_\Omega y^2dv=$（ ） $\frac{8\sqrt2-10}{15}\pi$ $\frac{8\sqrt2}{15}\pi$ $\frac{4\sqrt2+10}{15}\pi$ $\frac{8\sqrt2+10}{15}\pi$ $\iiint_\Omega y^2\,dv=\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}(r\sin\varphi\sin\theta)^2\cdot r^2\sin\varphi\,dr$

$=\int_0^{2\pi}\sin^2\theta\,d\theta\cdot\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^3\varphi\,d\varphi\cdot\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r^4\,dr=\pi\cdot\frac{8-5\sqrt{2}}{12}\cdot\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5}=\frac{8\sqrt{2}-10}{15}\pi$。

或者 $\iiint_\Omega y^2\,dv=\frac{1}{2}\iiint_\Omega(x^2+y^2)\,dv$

$=\frac{1}{2}\int_0^{2\pi}d\theta\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}d\varphi\int_0^{\sqrt{2}}r^4\cdot\sin^3\varphi\,dr=\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{5}\pi\int_0^{\frac{\pi}{4}}\sin^3\varphi\,d\varphi=\frac{8\sqrt{2}-10}{15}\pi$。
